operation_title: This method registers a new NF instance in the NRF, or replaces completely an existing NF instance.

request_body.description: Profile of the NF Instance to be registered, or completely replaced, in NRF.

response_body.description: This case represents the successful replacement of an existing NF Instance profile.

This case represents the successful registration of a new NF Instance. Upon success, a response body is returned containing the newly created NF Instance profile; also, the HTTP response shall include a "Location" HTTP header that contains the resource URI of the created NF Instance.

notes: This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.2-1.
No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.2-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.2-3.

NOTE: The mandatory HTTP error status codes for the PUT method listed in Table 5.2.7.1-1 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4] other than those specified in the table above also apply, with a ProblemDetails data type (see subclause 5.2.7 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4]).

constraints.statement: The request body shall contain exactly one NFProfile object.
The URI shall include the nfInstanceID path variable.
No query parameters are defined for this PUT operation; requests with query parameters shall be rejected.
A successful replacement of an existing NF instance shall return HTTP 200 OK.
A successful registration of a new NF instance shall return HTTP 201 Created.
A 201 Created response shall include a Location header containing the resource URI of the created NF instance.
A successful response body shall contain exactly one NFProfile object.
HTTP error responses applicable to PUT as defined in 3GPP TS 29.500 Table 5.2.7.1-1 shall also be supported.
Applicable HTTP error responses shall use the ProblemDetails data type.
